title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I have to write a story predicting Sept. 1 call-ups. From Gardy, it sounds like not many. Who should I predict? No quotes or anything, for my writing

Ok. But do not write it as a slam dunk although if anyone pays attention, it should not come as a surprise. most guys are already up and some have already been up. Candelario, Stewart, Greiner, Alexander. Stumph, and Shrieber. Brian Garcia has not been up but is in line and ready for a look.
